title: Glasses Prescription Sphere OD Leaderboard
dataSources: Contact lens orders (`contacts:order`), glasses prescriptions (`glasses:prescription`), vision exams (`vision:exam`), and lens replacement logs (`lens:replacement`).
app: Contact lens order exports, glasses prescription records, vision exam logs, and lens replacement reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=glasses:prescription sphere_od=*
| stats sum(sphere_od) as total_value, avg(sphere_od) as avg_value by optometrist
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks optometrist values by total and average sphere od across glasses prescription events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `sphere_od` values for each glasses prescription event and review total and average sphere od by optometrist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total sphere od.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which optometrist shows the biggest sphere od numbers in your glasses prescription data.
